hooks.summary: Reports any commit that changes openspec/ and lands without a valid Spec-check: trailer.
Blocks a hand-back for review (a pull request marked ready, or a review requested) that names its pull request while a change there is unread at its head on GitHub.
After a pull request is handed back for review with a change unread at its head, makes it a draft again, withdraws the review requests the call made, and tells the agent.
The same, after a command that hands back and then exits nonzero (Claude Code).
The same two checks for GitHub MCP calls in Cursor (unverified).
After a GitHub MCP call in Cursor hands a pull request back with a change unread, takes it back (unverified).
